prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 84.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 72.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.0%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Account Sync & Pet Recovery Hint', 'Story Screen Split Stage Redesign', 'Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome', 'Sign In Email Consistency Hint', 'Pet Adoption Spotlight Carousel Redesign', 'Pet Trait Grid Selection Redesign', 'Path Explorer Carousel Layout']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Split Screen Live Pet Preview', 'Waiting Screen Progress Bar & Time Estimate', 'Background Pet Generation Notification Flow', 'Account Sign-in Recovery Warning Hint', 'Generation Status Desktop Visibility Hint', 'Split Account Sync Sign-In Layout', 'Waiting Screen Care Tip Cards']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Move Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Interactive Controls Guide Screen', 'Interactive Pet Hatching Wait Flow', 'Path Selection Starter Benefits Banner', 'First Day Starter Gift Incentive', 'Desktop Controls Quick Reference Guide Layout', 'Pre-Desktop Waiting Interactive Tip Carousel Screen', 'Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Preview Flow', 'Story Screen Visual Path Choice Redesign', 'Photo Upload Custom Pet Quality Guidance Copy', 'Account Sign-In Sync Protection Layout', 'Post-Onboarding Pet Interaction Summary Screen', 'Desktop Readiness Setup Screen', 'Pet Naming & Identity Step', 'Instant Path Selection Headline Copy', 'Custom Photo Quality Clarity Hint', 'Desktop Controls Two-Column Welcome Layout']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions were generally too high for optimistic forecasts, whereas zero or negative predictions significantly underpredicted positive wins.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) are helpful overall, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+5.4% and +4.3%), despite an initial loss (-3.9%).
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) generally worked, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+4.3% and +6.3%), though one test showed a strong negative result (-4.3%).
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across both of its tests.
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish layout, home hint, home new_flow, and sign_in redesign, as each has only one test.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Pick Friend Stage Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pick friend screen into a stage layout with distinct pet personality cards and clear visuals to streamline pet adoption selection.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 27.3% drop-off rate and past adoption redesigns demonstrated strong positive conversion gains (+5.4% and +4.3%).

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet buddy to keep you company while you work or relax.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Basics Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated desktop interaction introduction screen right before final completion explaining how to hide, summon, and interact with the pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet once desktop setup finished.

new_desktop_controls.headline: Pet Interaction Basics
new_desktop_controls.body: Click your pet to interact. Right-click or use the taskbar icon anytime to hide or adjust settings.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Customization Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive official stamp component confirmation to the adoption certificate screen to confirm pet setup.
candidates.why: Adoption step drop-off is high (27.3%) with users taking a median 89s; interactive confirmation builds user attachment and completion commitment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review your pet companion details and stamp to finalize adoption.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Animated Companion Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen layout into a split view with animated pet rendering status feedback while pet files are created.
candidates.why: Home wait time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or desktop display issues.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Habitat
waiting.body: Your desktop companion is getting ready to land on your screen.

candidates.title: Existing Account Sync Clarity Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body text to clearly explain that logging into an existing account restores saved pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the single largest issue category) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary email.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Use your primary account email so your saved pets and desktop progress load seamlessly.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Visibility and Controls Hint
candidates.change: Add an informative tray visibility hint on the home intro welcome screen explaining how to bring the pet back if hidden.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing up on desktop and 3 emails asking how to control or bring back pets.

home_intro.hint: Pet missing or hidden? Click the system tray icon or press Ctrl+Shift+P to toggle desktop pet visibility.

candidates.title: Choose Path Two Column Choice Layout
candidates.change: Update the choose_path layout to a two-column grid format comparing path benefits directly side-by-side.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean completion time (514s), indicating user hesitation during path evaluation.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Upload Quality Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit photo quality guidance hint on the custom pet photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation failed or resulted in distorted pet visuals.

upload_photos.hint: Upload well-lit, clear front-facing photos with a simple background for best pet generation accuracy.

candidates.title: Home Intro Story Scroll Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the final home intro screen into a story scroll layout showcasing desktop pet habits and interactions.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 68.0% with very high mean completion time (5815s), needing a clearer final onboarding conclusion.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Pet's New Home!
home_intro.body: Scroll down to see how your companion lives alongside your daily tasks.

candidates.title: Account Login Persistence Status Hint
candidates.change: Add a persistence hint on the sign in screen confirming automatic pet state backup to account.
candidates.why: Sign-in drop-off is 20.3% and 8 support tickets involved account pet recovery issues.

sign_in.hint: Your pet companions and settings remain automatically linked to this email address.
